title: TomoClub | Kids who build with AI | TAICY 2026 Reel
notes: a_in/a_out: the words, in seconds of the source recording. v_in: the picture comes from that time instead.
view: project = the student's own game panel (oct04 share); game = the shared game screen; vk = the coach's tile; gallery = whole Zoom grid with every student tile blurred.
No caption, label or kept audio contains a student's name.

shots.head: A student built a game|*with AI.*
shots.text: Actually, I've made a game that I was making on Claude.

shots.head: For an *English test.*
shots.text: I was making this game for my English test.

shots.head: Quiz questions|*built right in.*
shots.text: And I've also put some questions to answer.

shots.head: Kids don't just use AI.|They *build* with it.
No rulebook.|*Figure it out together.*
shots.text: You know the rules, right? I don't give any rules. So you got to figure it out together.

shots.head: Live. As a team.|*In real time.*

shots.text: Okay, I got the last chip. Now we need to go to the platform.

shots.head: Same level. 3 minutes|down to *about 1.*
shots.text: You know, last time you took three minutes to complete the whole thing. This time you did it in under a minute or about a minute.

shots.head: What changed?|*They talked.*
shots.text: We were talking to each other.
It gives you clarity in a chaotic situation.

shots.head: Last place|*back to second.*
shots.text: So once I had gone down to last place,
and from there I recovered back to second place.

shots.head: That's *grit.*
shots.text: This is the grit I want from both of you.

shots.head: Kids' verdict: *10/10*
shots.text: I think a good 10 out of 10.
10 out of 10 out of 10. 10 out of 10!
